title: Unit Event — Perspective for Smile — Episode8 Conveying Feelings

meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime has finished training with Shunmeiza, and is set to study stage combat with the Mikazukigumi troupe. How will Emu and the others fare on this new, intensely physical stage?!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Today marks exactly one month since you all first joined us. The time we initially spoke about has finally arrived.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to seeing the results of all your hard work, Wonderlands×Showtime!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: So, feel free to start whenever you're ready!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're doing our play from start to finish this time! Let's put on the best performance we possibly can!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Your scene is first, right, Nene?
Break a leg!

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line:
“Your determination is admirable!
Unfortunately, the Minamoto clan must end here! Prepare yourself!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I feel stronger compared to before.
Even when I'm bumped around, I'm easily able to maintain my balance.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm honor-bound as the wife of a Minamoto, and have a duty to protect my children...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I need to send that message loud and clear!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Drop your katana and leave this place!
Only then shall I spare your life!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This is it. Our play's climax.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I hope Mr. Kijima approves of Emu's portrayal...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There are no right answers when it comes to acting, but...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu put an enormous amount of thought into this role, so let's trust her judgment.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“What nonsense do you speak?!
If you refuse to surrender, then it is my naginata you shall face...!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Yes, all that practice I did is paying off! I'm moving a lot more like Mr. Kijima did that time. I feel really relaxed!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (By dodging like he's dancing, I can show everyone just how much fun Ushiwakamaru's having right now.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Everyone's supposed to be giggling and snickering as they watch...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (What I think Ushiwakamaru's feeling in this moment...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I need to make that really clear to everyone!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Quit fooling around!
You are a mere child... But if you are going to call yourself a warrior, then unsheathe your katana and fight me!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Saying that only makes me want to take you even less seriously. Oh, missed me... Missed again...”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Really? He's feeling mischievous?
I totally thought Ushiwakamaru was just having a lot of fun battling against Benkei.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, I agree that you might want to make things easier for the audience. What if you paused for a moment in order to size up your opponent...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I have to take what everyone else saw and felt more into consideration. And then...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (After I dodge his naginata, I'll put some space between us.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (And Benkei will take another big swing at me with it.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Mr. Kijima looked really relaxed during this part. Like nothing bothered him at all.)

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: (A few centimeters in the other direction and she would've gotten hit. Why is she cutting things so close...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I'm gonna keep dodging at the last second while maintaining eye contact with Benkei.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (As Benkei realizes that Ushiwakamaru isn't taking him seriously, he starts swinging faster and faster.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (But Ushiwakamaru's just gonna keep drawing him closer and then dodging with ease. That's because...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (It's way too fun to see Benkei swing his naginata around after getting so angry!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Teasing Benkei just becomes more and more fun. And all that's left for Ushiwakamaru to do is...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“Well, that was a bit of an ordeal...
But teasing a ruffian such as yourself has been far too much fun.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Which means teasing an even bigger buffoon would be just that much more fun, no...?”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “I have no interest in restoring the Minamoto clan to its former glory, but making a plaything of brutes such as yourself is all too enticing.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “So, shall we go stir things up in this world a little?”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“Your name is Benkei, correct...?
Come with me. You will surely enjoy what we are going to see together.”

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: (So this is the answer Otori arrived upon...)

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: You've all made significant progress compared to when you first started. Your hard work has definitely paid off!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
How did I do...?
Were you able to see what my Ushiwakamaru was thinking and feeling?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Yeah, I heard you loud and clear!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: You really put your Ushiwakamaru's mischievousness on full display!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I was able to get my message across.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (He understood what my Ushiwakamaru was thinking and feeling...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Also, compared to before, I feel like I can see what other people are thinking as they watch a lot better now...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (What it's like to be a member of the audience going to see a show. When they smile, when they cry, when they laugh...)

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Alright, so... That concludes this rendition of Ushiwakamaru, Wonderlands×Showtime!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Let's all do our best as we work on our next production together!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Yeah, I have no complaints regarding your acting skills! And you all put in an incredible amount of effort this past month!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. We probably wouldn't have been able to achieve this result if it weren't for all your hard work, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sorry, have you already decided what your next production is going to be about...?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
No, not yet.
But we do have a venue lined up...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Hah hah hah! I hope you're all ready for this.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Mikazukigumi and Wonderlands×Showtime will be performing at the one and only...
